Clay on Hannity: Coach Obama, Democrats Dumping Patriotism, and the Knicks Visiting the White House
Clay appears on Hannity to discuss the significance of declining patriotism among Democrats, noting that you can’t have a great country when so many citizens don’t like it. Plus, Barack Obama says he’s as “coach” of the party! Also, a huge sign of a cultural shift: The New York Knicks are accepting President Trump’s invitation.
.
[@ClayTravis]and[@SeanHannity]discuss the significance of declining patriotism among Democrats, Barack Obama acting as "coach" of the party, and the New York Knicks making history as the first NBA champs to visit President Trump at the White House.[pic.twitter.com/MGZF34qmmG]— The Clay Travis & Buck Sexton Show (@clayandbuck)
[June 18, 2026]
